description: Customisable settings for the concierge app

title.description: Title shown in the browser tab

logo_light.description: Logo shown when using the light theme. Also used in generated PDF reports.

logo_dark.description: Logo shown when using the dark theme. Also used in generated PDF reports.

default_route.description: Route to use for the sidebar bookings link when no matching feature is enabled. e.g. `/book/rooms`

currency.description: Default currency code for pricing (e.g. catering orders). Defaults to `USD`

use_24_hour_time.description: Whether times are displayed using a 24 hour clock

week_start.description: Day of the week that calendars and week views start on. `0` for Sunday through `6` for Saturday. Defaults to `0`

use_region.description: Whether data is scoped to the active region instead of the active building. Affects desks, parking, lockers, visitors, signage, reports and other listings.

admin_group.description: Name of the user group that grants access to admin sections of the app. `placeos_admin` and `placeos_support` are always allowed. Defaults to `admin`

features.description: List of features enabled in the app. e.g. `spaces`, `zones`, `desks`, `parking`, `visitors`, `assets`, `facilities`, `internal-users`, `points`, `surveys`, `catering`, `events`, `booking-report`, `attendance-report`, `contact-tracing-report`, `signage`, `email-templates`

feature_groups.description: Mapping of feature names to the list of user groups allowed to access that feature. e.g. `parking-requests`. Features without an entry are available to all users.

delegated.description: Whether the PlaceOS instance uses delegated calendar access. When set, event actions are hidden from the event details view.

has_uploads.description: Whether file upload support (S3/cloud storage) is available in the app

vaccine_check.description: Whether vaccination checks are enabled for guests

custom_reports.description: Custom report pages to add to the reports section. Each report is rendered as an embedded page.

locales.description: List of locales that can be selected for the application

group_events_calendar.description: ID of the calendar used for storing group events

induction_enabled.description: Whether the visitor induction flow is enabled. Requires `induction_details` to be set.

induction_details.description: Text content of the visitor induction agreement shown in the induction modal

hide_sidebar.description: Whether to hide the application sidebar. Currently applied on the signage management view.

workplace_metadata_key.description: Name of the zone metadata key storing workplace app settings. Defaults to `workplace_app`

concierge_metadata_key.description: Name of the zone metadata key storing concierge app settings. Defaults to `concierge_app`

visitor_kiosk_metadata_key.description: Name of the zone metadata key storing visitor kiosk app settings. Defaults to `visitor-kiosk_app`

visitor_kiosk_app.description: Name of the zone metadata key read for visitor kiosk configuration (induction and visitor listing). Defaults to `visitor-kiosk_app`

concierge_app.description: Name of the zone metadata key written to by the induction settings modal. Defaults to `concierge_app`

workplace_url_path.description: URL path of the workplace app, used when generating desk QR code links. Defaults to `/workplace`

kiosk_url_path.description: URL path of the map kiosk app, used when generating point of interest and short URL links. Defaults to `/map-kiosk`

signage_path.description: URL path of the signage app, used when generating signage display URLs. Defaults to `/signage`

control_path.description: URL path of the room control app, used for links from the room manager listing

short_url_public_key.description: Public key used when generating short URLs for points of interest

bookings.description: General booking settings. Used as fallbacks for desk, parking and locker booking flows.

can_book_for_others.description: Whether users can create bookings on behalf of other users

use_building_timezone.description: Whether booking dates and times are handled in the active building's timezone instead of the local timezone. Affects desks, lockers, visitors and email broadcasts.

min_duration.description: Minimum booking duration in minutes. Defaults to `30`

max_duration.description: Maximum booking duration in minutes. Defaults to `480` (8 hours)

custom_duration_options.description: Custom list of selectable booking durations in minutes

available_period.description: Number of days into the future that bookings can be made. Defaults to `7`

allow_all_day.description: Whether all day bookings are allowed. Defaults to `true`

all_day_default.description: Whether the all day option is enabled by default for new bookings

desks.description: Settings associated with the desk booking flow

use_assets.description: Whether desk resources are read from and managed through the assets API instead of Zone metadata

can_book_for_others.description: Whether concierge users can create desk bookings on behalf of other users

max_assigned_count.description: Maximum number of desks that can be assigned to a single user. `0` for unlimited

hide_user_list_download.description: Whether to hide the desk booking user list download action on the desks view

default_duration.description: Default duration in minutes for new desk bookings. Defaults to `60`

all_day_default.description: Whether the all day option is enabled by default for new desk bookings. Falls back to `bookings.all_day_default`

allow_deleting.description: Whether desk bookings can be deleted from the desk bookings list. Defaults to `false`

events.description: Settings associated with meeting room bookings and the day view

allow_setup_breakdown.description: Whether setup and breakdown times can be viewed and set on room bookings

use_building_timezone.description: Whether event dates and times are handled in the active building's timezone instead of the local timezone

day_timeline_view.description: Layout of the day timeline. `default` shows rooms on the vertical axis, `inverted` shows rooms on the horizontal axis. Defaults to `default`

block_start.description: Earliest hour of the day (0-24) shown on the day timeline. Defaults to `0`

block_end.description: Latest hour of the day (0-24) shown on the day timeline. Defaults to `24`

block_height.description: Display height of each hour block on the day timeline. Defaults to `3`

custom_actions.description: Additional custom actions shown in the action menu of room bookings

allow_edit.description: Whether room bookings can be edited from the day view and booking lists

allow_deleting.description: Whether room bookings can be deleted from the room bookings list. Defaults to `false`

booking_unavailable.description: Whether the event calendar is unavailable. Hides event actions on room bookings.

hide_attendees.description: Whether to hide the attendees field in the event booking form

hide_notes.description: Whether to hide the notes field in the event booking form

has_assets.description: Whether assets can be requested as part of event bookings

allow_externals.description: Whether external attendees can be added to event bookings

allow_multiday.description: Whether events are allowed to span multiple days

strict_capacity_check.description: Whether attendee counts are strictly limited to the capacity of the selected space

max_duration.description: Maximum event duration in minutes. Defaults to `480` (8 hours)

available_period.description: Number of days into the future that events can be booked. Unset for no limit.

all_day_default.description: Whether the all day option is enabled by default for new event bookings

parking.description: Settings associated with parking bookings and requests

show_waitlist.description: Whether waitlisted parking bookings are shown in parking lists. Defaults to `true`

show_requests.description: Whether parking requests are shown in the parking section. Access can be restricted via the `parking-requests` feature group.

disable_bookings.description: Whether creating new parking reservations is disabled

disable_styles.description: Whether to disable status styling of parking spaces on the parking map

hide_bay_number.description: Whether to hide parking bay numbers in parking booking lists

hide_level_selector_on_booking_list.description: Whether to hide the level selector when viewing the parking booking list

hide_users.description: Whether to hide the users tab on the parking view

hide_vehicles.description: Whether to hide the vehicles tab on the parking view

hide_users_and_vehicles.description: Whether to hide both the users and vehicles tabs on the parking view

hide_availability_counter.description: Whether to hide the parking space availability counter in the parking topbar

hide_assign_space.description: Whether to hide the assign space action on parking bookings and requests

allow_editing.description: Whether parking bookings can be edited from parking lists. Defaults to `true`

allow_deleting.description: Whether parking bookings can be deleted from parking lists. Defaults to `false`

allow_all_day.description: Whether all day parking bookings are allowed

assign_space_on_approve.description: Whether a parking space is automatically assigned when approving a parking booking

max_assigned_count.description: Maximum number of parking spaces that can be assigned to a single user. `0` for unlimited

custom_booking_columns.description: Additional columns to display in the parking bookings list, sourced from booking extension data

use_building_timezone.description: Whether parking dates and times are handled in the active building's timezone. Falls back to `bookings.use_building_timezone`

min_duration.description: Minimum parking booking duration in minutes. Falls back to `bookings.min_duration`

max_duration.description: Maximum parking booking duration in minutes. Falls back to `bookings.max_duration`

custom_duration_options.description: Custom list of selectable parking booking durations in minutes. Falls back to `bookings.custom_duration_options`

available_period.description: Number of days into the future that parking can be booked. Falls back to `bookings.available_period`

lockers.description: Settings associated with the locker booking flow

disabled_date_select.description: Whether the date field is disabled in the locker booking form

disabled_start_time.description: Whether the start time field is disabled in the locker booking form

hide_end_time.description: Whether to hide the end time field in the locker booking form

allow_all_day.description: Whether all day locker bookings are allowed. Falls back to `bookings.allow_all_day`. Defaults to `true`

min_duration.description: Minimum locker booking duration in minutes. Falls back to `bookings.min_duration`. Defaults to `30`

max_duration.description: Maximum locker booking duration in minutes. Falls back to `bookings.max_duration`. Defaults to `480` (8 hours)

custom_duration_options.description: Custom list of selectable locker booking durations in minutes. Falls back to `bookings.custom_duration_options`

available_period.description: Number of days into the future that lockers can be booked. Falls back to `bookings.available_period`. Defaults to `7`

visitors.description: Settings associated with the visitor management view

all_visitors_action_window.description: Time window in minutes before an event starts and after it ends during which bulk actions are available for all visitors of the event. Defaults to `15`

hide_fields.description: List of field names to hide in the visitor listing

allow_international.description: Whether international visitor details are enabled in visitor listings and reports

has_parking.description: Whether parking can be arranged for visitors. Requires the `parking` feature to be enabled.

allow_printing_label.description: Whether visitor labels can be printed from the visitor listing. Defaults to `true`

allow_pass_number.description: Whether pass numbers can be set for visitors. Defaults to `true`

reports.description: Settings associated with the reports section

features.description: List of report types shown in the reports menu. Defaults to `attendance`, `desks`, `spaces`, `catering` and `contact-tracing`

attendance_include_weekends.description: Whether weekends are included in attendance report calculations

ignore_days.description: Days of the week to exclude from report calculations. Either day names (e.g. `saturday`) or day indexes (0-6)

use_bookings.description: Whether catering orders are sourced from the bookings API instead of calendar events. Affects catering reports.

bookable_hours.description: Bookable time window as hours of the day (0-24). For example, `8` is 8:00 AM and `19` is 7:00 PM.

start.description: Earliest allowed booking start time as hour of the day (0-24).

end.description: Latest allowed booking end time as hour of the day (0-24).

logo.description: Logo to display. Either a URL string or an object with a `src` URL.

name.description: Translation key or display name for the locale

local.description: Name of the locale in its own language

flag.description: Flag emoji to display alongside the locale name

id.description: Unique URL-safe identifier for the report

name.description: Display name shown in the reports menu

url.description: URL of the report page to embed

id.description: Unique identifier for the action, passed to the action handler when selected

name.description: Display name of the action in the menu

icon.description: Material Symbols icon name to show next to the action

field.description: Name of the booking extension data field to display

name.description: Display name for the column header

display_name.description: Alternative display name for the column header
